title: Core: page blocks, islands, family footer
description: Opt-in standard front end features so the Cyclotron, Chatticus and Tactus marketing sites need no chrome/layout code: ::band/::column/::button/::island page blocks and {{value}} tokens, an islands runtime, header brand and nav groups, and the Anthus family footer. YAGNI; sites using none render byte for byte as before.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shipped: page blocks, islands and family footer are in core and in use on cyclotron.anth.us, chattic.us and tactus.anth.us (live 200). Stories c9952a, fc93e4 closed; follow-ups landed in PR #464.
